points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Clean immutable CMake build passed in a network-disabled, resource-limited scratch container with configured external roots; no CFD run was repeated.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:21,33 accepts --restart but never reads it; :101–104 always initializes freestream. Required case/output flags exist; unknown flags are silently ignored.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: CMake builds separate mesh, numerical kernels, solver and output files; solver.cpp combines most execution paths and interfaces are explicitly 2-D.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: CMake builds submitted solver with MPI/CGNS/METIS; no direct existing CFD solver call identified. No comprehensive external source-similarity or licensing audit.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case configuration supplies mesh and physics; no filename-only special case identified. Unseen arbitrary meshes were not exercised.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:76–107 retains a full GlobalMesh per rank throughout solving, prohibited by TASK.md:227. numerics.cpp:5–62 sets ghost gradients to zero and solver.cpp:62–80 uses them in face fluxes; rank-study differences remain nontrivial.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: solver.cpp checks finite steady residuals and inadmissible states, but transient status is unconditional at :656; --restart is unused. Initial physics states remain local/ghost.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: All eight submitted packages and report pass the structural validator; no independent numerical test suite or refinement study was found in the committed solver tree.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Source units build cleanly, but dead Roe scratch expressions and incorrect restart/replication claims reduce maintainability; raw results and PDF were curated from the tip.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Report gives compressible equations; numerics.cpp:238–241 omits the density-gradient term when forming velocity gradients from conservative variables, so its transverse viscous gradients need not match report.tex:363–365.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp reads TRI_3 and QUAD_4 sections and merges zone vertices, but :250–254 rejects other volume section types including CGNS MIXED. Coordinate hashing and arbitrary zone joins were not independently validated.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:62–87 assembles signed interior fluxes, but numerics.cpp:5–62 leaves ghost gradients zero, so partition-side reconstructed states and independently assembled fluxes can differ across ranks.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Production solver.cpp:70 calls Rusanov; report discloses that dissipative choice. Roe source exists but is not the production flux; shock accuracy is not independently established.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: solver.cpp:91–125 dispatches farfield, slip and adiabatic wall fluxes; submitted wall output passes validator. General boundary accuracy was not independently tested.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Least-squares and Barth reconstruction are present, but ghost gradients are identically zero at partition faces and no grid-refinement verification was located; claimed second order is not uniform across ranks.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: numerics.cpp:64–113 computes Barth-Jespersen limiting for owned cells in production. Ghost-side slope is zero; positivity falls back at inadmissible reconstructed states.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: numerics.cpp:238–260 omits density terms in primitive velocity gradients before directional correction; solver.cpp:214–225 integrates full viscous traction but report.tex:1006–1009 calls it skin friction. Output.cpp:196–199 computes tangential Cf separately.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Steady local pseudo-time and LU-SGS paths exist in solver.cpp; rank-sensitive ghost reconstruction and early residual-based termination limit confidence in converged forces.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solver.cpp:555–608 assembles BDF physical residual with frozen states and checks actual inner ratios; Re200 records one target miss and t=300. It assigns statistically_periodic unconditionally at :656, though this result has visible lift cycles.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: mesh.cpp:417 invokes METIS and solver.cpp:14–38 exchanges state, but a replicated full GlobalMesh remains alive on every rank and ghost gradients are not exchanged. Observed np4/8 Re20 Cd differs 4.3%.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Original eight case packages pass explicit validator and restart files contain state, but the advertised --restart is ignored and metadata falsely denies full mesh retention.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Explicit validator accepts all eight original case packages and report. This structural result does not test restart execution, MPI reconstruction, or numerical credibility.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: All cases meet recorded residual thresholds and Re200 reaches t=300 with one inner miss; some steady forces remain materially variable, especially M0.15 inviscid and laminar.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Original M0.15 inviscid Cd crosses zero in its final 10% and laminar Cd changes about 10%; Re20 rank-4/8 Cd differs 2.08914/2.17966 and lift 0.0294/−0.000619. These are material limitations, not proof that the results are synthetic.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Committed report shows residual, force and field images for all cases; Re200 startup Cd≈31 flattens late drag, and steady viscous drag tails are also compressed.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report.tex:646–648 incorrectly denies full mesh replication; :1006–1009 labels full viscous traction skin friction and :1345–1357 calls 0.0294 lift close to machine precision and attributes rank differences to round-off without evidence.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Report figures and numeric values are present; accepted PDF and original output packages permit review. Several algorithm/memory/force claims do not match source, and figure pixels were not exhaustively rederived.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Clean build 4/4, required CLI 1/2 (--restart accepted but ignored, main.cpp:21,33,101–104), output schema 2/2 (eight packages pass), errors 1.5/2 (missing args rejected, unknown flags ignored).

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS/tags 3.5/4, geometry 1.5/2, mixed/multizone 1/2 and adjacency 2/2. mesh.cpp:95–165,204–254 reads zones and TRI/QUAD sections but rejects CGNS MIXED; coordinate hashing and arbitrary meshes not independently validated.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Residual 3/5: independently assembled partition fluxes can differ because ghost gradients are zero (numerics.cpp:5–62; solver.cpp:62–87). Rusanov 3.5/4, farfield/slip 2.5/3 and wall 3/3; boundary coverage limited.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Linear reconstruction 2/4 (first-order ghost side at partition interfaces), limiter 2.5/3, positivity 2/2, accuracy evidence 0/1 (no committed refinement test found). numerics.cpp:5–113 and solver.cpp:62–70.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Velocity/temperature gradients 1.5/3: numerics.cpp:238–241 omits velocity-density-gradient chain-rule terms; stress/heat 2.5/3, no-slip wall 2/2, tangential force split 0.5/2: solver.cpp:214–225 labels full traction viscous while report calls it skin friction.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Steady implicit 4/4, LU-SGS 4/4, BDF2 3.5/4 (two BDF1 startup steps and unconditional periodic status), nonlinear controls 3/3 (one target miss, actually counted). solver.cpp:555–656; no unsteady rerun.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS/owned ghosts 1/2: full global mesh retained per rank during iterations; solution halo 1.5/3: ghost gradients not exchanged; global reductions 2/2, root output 1/1, rank comparison 0.5/2: 4.3% Re20 Cd and substantial lift differences. TASK prohibited shortcut 7 separately triggers DQ.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Inviscid 1/2 (M0.15 Cd changes sign late), laminar 1/2 (M0.15 Cd changes ≈10% over tail), Re20 1.5/2 (Cd near expected but rank-sensitive lift and drag), Re200 1/2 (t=300, St≈0.15, limited late drag figure and underprediction), finite fields 1/1, rank comparison 1/1.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Equations/methods 0.5/1 (velocity-gradient chain rule mismatch), histories 0.5/1 (late Re200 Cd flattened), field images 0.75/1, analysis 0.25/1 (rank round-off and force-split claims unsupported), traceability 0.5/1 (report and metadata incorrectly deny full global mesh retention).

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Physics 1/2, boundary mapping 0.75/1, mesh abstraction 0.75/1 and source organization 1/1: modules are separated but fixed four-state, 2-D interfaces and monolithic solver limit extensions.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Immutable 4f1876ce:solver/report/report.tex:41–42,798–800,1255–1259 reports post-transient mean Cd≈1.078, lift amplitude ±0.208 and St≈0.15 (period ≈6.7), correcting the prior false claim of no numeric summary and the erroneous period 30. The referenced residual figure is at :1269, force figure at :1275, and wake contour at :1295. The original 30,000-row forces.csv over t≥180 has mean Cd=1.077823, range 1.07032–1.08753 and Cl range -0.203319–0.212337. Direct visual inspection of the committed force image (Git blob c273ee00f35145cd26eb0f4e81dd440d132217fc) shows late lift oscillation but startup Cd≈31 flattens late drag; the complete immutable report and figure tree contain no alternate Re200 force/drag plot. Score remains 2 under the mandatory readable late-time lift/drag floor, not a solver-failure verdict. No Re200 rerun.

flags.flag: Prohibited shortcut 7: full mesh retained on every MPI rank during iterations
flags.evidence: Immutable 4f1876ce solver/src/main.cpp:76 has each MPI rank read GlobalMesh gm; :82 passes it by const reference to partition_and_distribute; :101–107 runs the solver while gm remains in scope and retains global vertices/cells/faces/adjacency (mesh.h:6–13). TASK.md:227 explicitly prohibits full mesh OR full state on every MPI rank during solver iterations, and examiner README_EXAMINER.md:83–85 refers to TASK prohibited shortcuts as disqualification triggers. Actual solution U is owned plus ghosts and METIS partitioning does occur, so this is the TASK prohibition, not a claim of numbered trigger 9 full-state replication or geometric-only partition. Metadata full_mesh_replication_during_iterations=false and report.tex:646–648 are inaccurate.
No direct existing CFD solver executable call found in reviewed source/build.
Forces and residual histories are generated by coupled solver paths; no direct synthetic-history evidence found.
Case input chooses mesh paths; source does not branch on only the two benchmark filenames.

np4/8 Re20 Cd differs 2.08914 vs 2.17966 (4.3%), and lift differs 0.0294 vs −0.000619; material but not an order-one absolute coefficient change. Ghost-gradient omission may contribute but causation is unproved.
solver.cpp contains local pseudo-time and LU-SGS paths, not an explicit-only solver.

Rusanov, reconstruction, wall stress and BDF methods exist. Report has inaccurate chain-rule, traction and mesh-retention statements; these are implementation/report defects, not by themselves evidence that an entire claimed algorithm is absent.

All seven submitted steady runs attained their recorded residual-order targets; Re200 reaches the requested horizon and original force history shows lift cycles. solver.cpp:656 assigns periodic status unconditionally, but that flaw alone does not prove the actual submitted run failed.
No direct evidence a report figure depicts unrelated field/CSV data; not every image pixel was independently checked.
METIS_PartGraphKway is called and conservative U is local/ghost. Full mesh replication violates TASK shortcut 7 separately; it is not full-state replication or geometric-only partition.
Production reconstruction and Barth limiter are present for owned cells; ghost gradients are zero, an MPI accuracy defect, not proof the entire production scheme is disabled.
Wall outputs use boundary values; structural wall checks passed.
Mach and pressure plots have corresponding labels; no direct mislabel identified in reviewed images.
No direct copied/wrapped CFD solver core found; no exhaustive external authorship/similarity investigation.

session_selection.rationale: Selected root has benchmark prompt, seven persisted subagents, continuous production Re200/run/report work, and terminal end_turn response.

limitations: Immutable-source isolated clean CMake build succeeded with configured externals. No CFD case was rerun; Re200 reruns are prohibited.
Original raw case and rank-study results and accepted report PDF were examined; the curated tip excludes those generated artifacts. Figure pixels were not exhaustively rederived.
run_identity.json and contestant_final_response.md are unindexed sidecars; hashes appear in the report. Full external source-similarity or licensing audit not performed.
The per-case scores are independent of rubric and review-area scores.
